title: Descant Recorder
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Performance directions named in words on the phone; play G major pieces in class.

skills.key_step: The child explains recorder technique (finger pads, gentle steady breath, tonguing) and reads directions: p soft, f loud, crescendo, diminuendo, repeat signs.

floor.prerequisite: Names what to check before playing (Grade 7).
floor.question: Which tells how fast to play?

contexts: a G major piece for a concert

misconceptions.ask: How should you blow a descant recorder?
misconceptions.repair: Blow hard, then gently; hear the squeak.

misconceptions.ask: What does p mean in music?
misconceptions.repair: p for piano: soft. f for forte: loud.

misconceptions.ask: What does a repeat sign mean?
misconceptions.repair: Play to the repeat sign and go back to the start.
Play a scale getting louder at the same speed.

checks.question: What does a repeat sign tell you?
